scope: The cell lysate was collected by scraping the plate and boiled for an additional 10 min

Monolayer-cultured cells were lysed with 200 µl of boiling lysis buffer (5% SDS; 100 mM Tris pH 8.5, 5 mM TCEP, and 10 mM CAA) and incubated at 95 °C, for 10 min with mixing (1000 rpm).
